Hi! I'd like to request a romantic scene between Princess Veronica (ヴェロニカ) and Prince Marks (マークス) from the Fire Emblem series. Below are the character design references:

Veronica:
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/00001005000881-2/
(The wings are not part of Veronica's body; they are a part of the dress she wears)

Marks:
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/11005002000027-2/

Veronica is around 155 cm tall, while Marks is around 190 cm tall.

In the crossover title Fire Emblem Heroes (FEH), Marks becomes a close ally to Veronica, and acts as her mentor and a "big brother" figure. In the scenario from the requested illustration, Veronica is seducing Marks, who gives in to Veronica's charm.

Veronica must be wearing a maid outfit from Marks' kingdom, instead of her usual outfit. Here's some references for the outfit that Veronica must wear:
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/11007001000290-2/
https://www.reddit.com/r/fireemblem/comments/d4sqpj/i_drew_generic_maid/

In FEH, the two characters live in Veronica's palace. The setting of the illustration should be inspired on this image of said palace:
https://files.catbox.moe/hnc6kc.webp

Marks must be sitting in a couch, while Veronica is on top of Marks. Veronica must assertively get close to Marks, while the two look passionately at each other, as if they were about to kiss. Here's an example similar to the described scenario:
https://twitter.com/_REIJI03/status/1512713174297972736

Feel free to adjust the poses however you see fit. However, please use a perspective from which the high-heeled boots and the back of Veronica's maid outfit are visible. Veronica's and Marks' passionate and loving gazes should still be visible, please.

Finally, if possible, I'd like to request an extra version that adds a few small inset panels showing the two characters lovingly kissing. These additional panels should focus only on the characters' mouths as they passionately kiss each other.

Thanks for your consideration!

Reference for Nanna can be found at https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/04001003000237/

Thanking you in advance!

Thank you very much!
